text: Specifies the final status of a transaction.
Specifies the reason the transaction/instruction is unmatched.
Specifies the underlying reason for cancellation of the associated transaction.
Specifies the reason the transaction/instruction is suspended.
Specifies the reason the transaction/instruction is pending failing settlement, and the settlement at the instruction settlement date is no longer possible.

Specifies the reason the transaction/instruction is pending settlement, that is, pending delivery or receipt of the financial instrument. Settlement on the instructed settlement date is still possible.
